original_evidence: List the claims separately per item and per pair
record four assessments
treat each lineage as one line of evidence however many clues it contains
First check that the external record was not itself compiled from this bundle.
neutral_evidence: List claims separately for each item and each pair
record four assessments
count each group as one line of evidence regardless of its number of clues

operation_preserved.rationale: The paraphrase preserves claim separation, all four clue assessments, grouping by common origin, external-record provenance checks, per-claim outcomes and testing physical arrangement as custody or filing evidence.

original_evidence: two or more separately originating lineages overlap on the same material feature
intervals from different lineages are disjoint, or order relations conflict
the claim rests on a single lineage
wording or errors shared between an annotation and an accession record
neutral_evidence: at least two separately originating groups overlap on the same property of a claim
intervals from different origin groups are disjoint or order relations conflict
a claim rests on a single origin group
wording or errors shared by an annotation and an accession record
signal_preserved.rationale: All three observable outcomes retain their criteria, including lack of support when clues date the wrong property. The indicators of dependence and illustrative dating signals are also preserved.

original_evidence: Where independent, credible lineages converge
stated as an interval and not as a point date
a complete sequence is warranted only if every pair is independently supported
It does not warrant accepting the single clue's date, and it does not warrant rejecting it.
neutral_evidence: When independent, credible groups of clues converge
expressed as an interval rather than a point date
A complete sequence is warranted only if every pair is independently supported.
this neither warrants accepting nor rejecting the single clue's date
inference_preserved.rationale: The same conditional basis supports interval overlap and relative order. Partial ordering, unresolved contradictions, retained alternatives, wider bounds without independent support and the negative inference limits remain intact.

original_evidence: Convergence can also come from the assessor's own shared assumptions
credibility here means the reliability of a clue type and the authenticity of an instance
Independence often cannot be demonstrated from the items alone and may remain a judgement.
No observations have been made.
neutral_evidence: Apparent convergence may also result from the assessor's shared assumptions
Credibility concerns clue-type reliability and instance authenticity.
Independence often cannot be demonstrated from the items alone and may remain a judgement.
No observations have been made, and no bundle contents are supplied.
limit_preserved.rationale: Shared origins, persistent material characteristics, unequal dating access and assessor assumptions remain explicit limitations. The definition of credibility preserves the target-side restriction while removing the informant analogy. Unchecked assumptions, uncertain independence, unknown outcomes and possible reliance on bundle-level bounds are retained.

original_evidence: stop narrowing a claim when every remaining clue belongs to a lineage already counted, or when no further independent anchor is available
Record the interval at its current width.
neutral_evidence: Stop narrowing a claim when every remaining clue belongs to an origin group already counted or when no further independent source of dating evidence is available.
Record the interval at its current width.
stopping_condition_preserved.rationale: Both alternative stopping triggers and the instruction to preserve the current interval width are unchanged in meaning.

original_evidence: for contradictory or unsupported claims, seek another independent anchor, re-examine the conflicting clue's access and dependence, or compare another document or reference
Keep alternative chronologies on record until one is excluded by independent evidence.
neutral_evidence: For contradictory or unsupported claims, seek another independent source of dating evidence, re-examine the conflicting clue's access and dependence, or compare another document or reference.
Keep alternative chronologies on record until independent evidence excludes one.
next_inquiry_preserved.rationale: The triggers, alternative follow-up actions and condition for discarding a chronology are preserved. Testing the listed explanations for contradictions restates the original inference field's candidate explanations to test.

original_evidence: The claims are of three kinds
Each assumption is itself an open claim to be checked.
Both alternatives are kept, together with the candidate explanations to test
neutral_evidence: Claims have three forms
remain separate open claims
For contradictions, test the retained candidate explanations
no_added_operational_content.rationale: The additional organization restates existing claim types, assumptions and inference structure. Moving explanation testing into next inquiry adds no new action, evidence requirement, decision rule or scope.

original_evidence: lineages of common origin
independent anchor
Documents and material features are not reporting agents
not the track record of an informant
neutral_evidence: Group clues by common origin
independent source of dating evidence
Credibility concerns clue-type reliability and instance authenticity.
no_source_imagery.rationale: The paraphrase removes lineage and anchor imagery and the reporting-agent/informant comparison. It retains the correspondence, material clues, custodians and records as target entities. Assessment terms are defined directly in terms of dating clues.

no_verdict_language.rationale: Neither text characterizes the procedure as ordinary, native, novel, unorthodox, creative, merely formalization or a material departure, or claims it adds or lacks a new warrant. Statements about justified chronology describe evidential conclusions rather than evaluate the procedure.

uncertainty: The underlying dating outcomes remain unknown: no observations or bundle contents are supplied, independence may remain a judgement, and some items may retain only bundle-level bounds. These uncertainties are preserved.
